free_tier.stated: Free, no account: '收录超百万的网盘资源搜索引擎'. Search across 百度网盘, 阿里云盘, 夸克, 迅雷, UC, 蓝奏云 and 115.

per_object_cap.stated: Not applicable: it indexes share links, it does not host files.

retention.stated: Index lifetime is not published; dead share links are the normal state of such an index.

egress.terms: No traffic of its own: each result is a share link on the pan that holds the file, so the pan's egress terms apply once the client opens it.

interface_detail: HTTP GET /search?q=... returns an HTML page of share links; no JSON endpoint was found.
tooling: Browser. Results are pan share links with extraction codes, so a user still needs a way to open them (a pan account or a 代下).
chaining: The discovery half of retrieval: this is where a share link comes from, and every result it returns is subject to the identity wall of the pan behind it.

identity_cost.detail: No account and no login for searching; the page renders results to an anonymous visitor.

reliability_note: An index of other people's shares, with the usual decay: a search result is not a live file, and the 115 API suspension plus 夸克's share purges shorten link life.
confidence_note: The landing page and its topic links were read today. A search was not run, so recall and dead-link rate are unmeasured.

evidence.proved: '收录超百万的网盘资源搜索引擎'; description names 百度网盘、阿里云盘、夸克、迅雷、UC、蓝奏云、115; search links at /search?q=

notes: Free aggregation is the only retrieval layer with no identity cost at all, which is why it is the front door for the rest of this market.
binding_note: No quota of its own; the pan behind each link is what a user meets next.
